text:
Evan (AE): Handoff: HelixWell closed. Deployment: Private in eu-west-1. Must-haves: SAML SSO, GDPR data residency, audit logs to external SIEM, and per-route token billing exported to our billing system. They plan pilot with 3 clinician users next week. Renewal window: Q4; procurement timeline is tight 90d risk if integration slips. Need CSM owner + eng escalation path.

Casey (CSM): Ill own onboarding and enablement. Please share customer contact and AWS account. Also need sample prompts and expected concurrency for sizing.

Lin (SE): Provisioned a staging node in private-eu-west-1. Need their VPC CIDR and SAML metadata. Recommend enabling KV caching for clinical templates to reduce latencies.

Harper (Support): Opening infra ticket: <https://redwood.example.com/tickets/8299|ticket-8299>. Tags: helixwell, gdpr, private. Assigning to Lin + infra. ETA triage 6h. ops-bot will post updates here. :gear:

Evan (AE): Contact: jo@helixwell.health, aws acct 666777888999. They requested an enablement session next Thu. Also asked about KMS integration and log retention for audits.

Casey (CSM): Scheduling Thu 10am CET. I'll include a slide on KMS + retention and a checklist for SOC2-like audit items. Owners: Casey = CSM/onboarding; Lin = infra; Harper = support ticket/triage; Evan = sales escalation. Any blockers?

Lin (SE): Posting peering snippet in ticket-8299. Customer-side example:

```
# Add route to Redwood peering
Destination: 10.70.0.0/16
Target: pcx-0c3d4e5f6a
```

Lin (SE): I'll also upload SG rules and SIEM forwarding config. Recommend starting with 4vCPU/16GB for pilot and scale after first week.

ticket-bot: ticket-8299 status: created -> triage_pending. Next update ~4h.

Harper (Support): Linked onboarding doc: https://redwood.example.com/onboard/helixwell. Marking demo blocked until peering + SAML metadata validated. Will run smoke test when ready. :white_check_mark:

Casey (CSM): I'll collect clinician use-cases and the prompt set ahead of the demo. Post-demo I'll run a short survey and escalate any quality regressions to Research. Also adding renewal_watch tag in CRM given procurement sensitivity.

Evan (AE): thanks all. Follow-ups: Casey send invite, Lin update ticket with SGs and SIEM details, Harper validate peering and run smoke test, Evan follow up on DPA. Ping here if anything stalls.
